home.scenariosLede: Four moments from inside operations we've walked into. Pain → bottleneck → system installed → measurable outcome. No composites, no hypotheticals.

scenarios.s1Scene: Three people walk past the QR code outside. Two screenshot it for later. By Sunday morning, they have forgotten.
scenarios.s1Bottleneck: After-hours capture is broken across voicemail, social DMs, and paper notes. Nothing routes to the floor manager until Monday, if at all.
scenarios.s1SystemDesc: Every after-hours enquiry captured, qualified, confirmed within two minutes. Routing rules sized to the kitchen capacity for that day.
scenarios.s2Scene: Reception is on three calls. Two more come in. The fourth caller hangs up after seven rings and books with the practice down the road.
scenarios.s2Bottleneck: Phone system has no queue intelligence and no fallback to text or email. Booked appointments get logged manually into the calendar.
scenarios.s2SystemDesc: Overflow calls route to AI triage that captures intent, books available slots, or schedules a callback, with full audit trail per DSGVO.
scenarios.s3Scene: Field tech sends a photo of the completed roof job plus a handwritten total over WhatsApp. The office retypes it into the spreadsheet. The invoice goes out Friday. Maybe.
scenarios.s3Bottleneck: A 36-hour gap between work complete and invoice sent. Cash flow lags one week behind reality. XRechnung compliance still done by hand.
scenarios.s3SystemDesc: Photo to quote to invoice in 90 seconds. XRechnung-compliant by default. Field team works from one app; office sees it live.
scenarios.s3ResultDetail: with full audit trail and tamper-proof history
scenarios.s4Scene: Reception scrambles for 47 binders. Senior carers stop care delivery to assemble evidence, care plans, training records, medication logs, incident reports.
scenarios.s4Bottleneck: Compliance evidence lives across paper, email, Drive folders, and individual carers' phones. Every inspection is a fire drill that pulls senior staff off the floor for a week.
scenarios.s4SystemDesc: Evidence pack assembled continuously, not at inspection time. Drift alerts when policy or training fall behind. Audit-on-demand is a button click.
scenarios.s4ResultDetail: senior carers stay on the floor

faq.title: Common questions
faq.q1: How long does it take to build and deploy an automation?
faq.a1: Most single automations go live in 7-14 days. Complex multi-system builds take 3-6 weeks. We work in clear phases: scope, build, test, launch. You always know where we are.
faq.q2: Do I need technical knowledge to use what you build?
faq.a2: No. Everything is designed to run silently in the background. Dashboards are read-only summaries, your team continues working in the tools they already know.
faq.q3: What tools do you actually use?
faq.a3: Whatever fits the operation: n8n, Make, Claude AI, OpenAI, Supabase, Neon, Next.js, Resend, Twilio. We pick by what the system needs, not by what we prefer.
faq.q4: Will this work with our existing software?
faq.a4: Yes. Every system we install integrates via API, webhook, or direct database. If your tool has any way to read or write data, we can plug into it.
faq.q5: What happens after you build it?
faq.a5: You own the system. We hand over full documentation, deployment access, and a 30 to 60-day support window depending on the plan. Ongoing management is optional.
faq.a6: Contact us with a short description of what you need. We will reply within one business day.

layers.l1OneLiner: The layer that turns every channel a customer reaches you on into one structured, qualified, routed stream.
layers.l1Pain: Enquiries leak through email, phone, WhatsApp, web, walk-ins. Response times slip from minutes to hours. Hot leads cool while staff bounce between inboxes.
layers.l1System: Multi-channel intake landing in a single queue. Auto-qualification against your ICP. Routing to the right person or on-call shift, with full audit trail. After-hours capture without losing context.
layers.l1Result: Avg first response: from 4 hours to under 10 minutes. Zero leads lost between channels.
layers.l2OneLiner: The orchestration layer that connects field crews to the back office without paper, WhatsApp threads, or evening re-keying.
layers.l2Pain: Field crews work off WhatsApp and clipboards. Office staff retype job notes into invoicing the next day. Photos sit in private camera rolls. Time logs are guessed at month-end.
layers.l2System: GPS-tracked dispatch and time logging. Photo-to-quote on site, becoming structured invoice drafts. Digital customer signatures. Live sync between field actions and back-office systems.
layers.l2Result: ~9 hours/week reclaimed per crew. Zero re-entry errors. Invoicing cycle from 2 weeks to same-day.
layers.l3OneLiner: The layer that runs everything between work-completed and cash-collected, without retyping, chasing, or month-end fire drills.
layers.l3Pain: Invoices arrive as photos, PDFs, paper. Approvals stall in inboxes. XRechnung compliance is an afterthought. Cash flow waits on whoever has time tonight.
layers.l3System: OCR + extraction with validation rules. Approval workflows with role boundaries. XRechnung-compliant outbound invoicing. Reconciliation against POs and ledgers. Payment tracking with overdue logic.
layers.l3Result: 90%+ of inbound documents processed without human touch. Approval cycle hours instead of days. DSO measurably shorter.
layers.l4OneLiner: The layer that absorbs inbound volume, support email, chat, social, voicemail, and only surfaces what genuinely needs a human.
layers.l4Pain: One shared inbox carries support, sales, complaints and supplier questions. The same fifteen questions get answered fifty times a week. Threads die mid-conversation when nobody owns them.
layers.l4System: Auto-classification of inbound traffic. Draft replies for FAQs. Self-service portal for repeat questions. Routing + escalation policy. Conversation ownership tracking with SLAs.
layers.l4Result: Inbound human-handled volume drops 60–80%. SLA breaches surface as alerts, not surprises. Same-day response on what matters.
layers.l5OneLiner: The layer that keeps you continuously audit-ready, instead of treating every audit as a fire drill.
layers.l5Pain: CQC, GDPR, XRechnung, §19 UStG, internal QA, every audit means three days of evidence-hunting. Drift between policy and reality only surfaces when an inspector arrives.
layers.l5System: Continuous compliance posture across every system you run. Auto-assembled evidence packs on demand. Drift alerts when policy and operational reality diverge. Tamper-proof activity log.
layers.l5Result: Audit prep from days to button-press. Drift events caught before they become findings. Continuous posture report for leadership.
layers.l6OneLiner: The operational watchtower, KPIs, anomalies, SLA breaches, supplier exceptions, stock drift, surfaced as alerts before they become losses.
layers.l6Pain: Operational pain is usually noticed too late. Stockouts after they happen. Missed bookings after the client phones to complain. Supplier exceptions when payroll arrives short.
layers.l6System: Live KPI watch across every system you run. Anomaly detection per channel. Defined escalation paths with owners. Exception alerts that route to the right desk, not the team chat.
layers.l6Result: Operational surprises drop. SLA breaches caught while they're still reversible. Leadership sees real-time operational health, not weekly snapshots.

services.boundaryDesc: Saying yes to everything is how agencies become forgettable. These are the things we turn down, every time, on purpose.

boundary.n1No: One-shot automations with no operational ownership
boundary.n1Why: A workflow that nobody monitors decays. We only build systems we (or your team, trained by us) keep running.
boundary.n2No: Random content posting with no revenue logic
boundary.n2Why: Content only matters when it supports visibility, trust, leads, sales or retention. We build growth content systems with approval, tracking and clear business purpose.
boundary.n3No: GPT-wrapper chatbots without grounded data and escalation policy
boundary.n3Why: A chatbot without a self-service knowledge base, escalation rules, and audit trail is a liability dressed as a feature.
boundary.n4No: No-code prototypes presented as production systems
boundary.n4Why: Zaps and Make scenarios are fine prototypes. They're not infrastructure unless they're wrapped in monitoring, recovery, and ownership.
boundary.n5Why: Most operational pain isn't solved by AI. It's solved by removing handovers, defining ownership, and installing the missing layer.

caseStudies.cs1Challenge: An operations team managing complex programme delivery was spending over 60% of staff time on manual data entry, report compilation, and cross-referencing records across multiple spreadsheets. caseStudies.cs1Solution: We deployed a document processing AI pipeline that automatically extracts, validates, and categorises incoming reports and records. caseStudies.cs1Result3: Error rate dropped from 8% to under 0.5%
caseStudies.cs1Result4: Programme managers receive auto-generated weekly summaries
caseStudies.cs2Challenge: A mid-sized consulting firm was manually processing client invoices, reconciling expenses, and generating monthly financial reports. Three members of the finance team spent an average of 2 days per month solely on invoice reconciliation. With a growing client base, this was becoming unsustainable.
caseStudies.cs2Solution: We built a fully automated invoice processing system that ingests invoices via email, extracts line items using document AI, validates against purchase orders in their ERP, and posts approved invoices directly to Xero. A Slack notification alerts the finance lead only when human review is required.
caseStudies.cs2Result2: Invoice processing time cut from 2 days to 90 minutes/month
caseStudies.cs2Result3: 94% of invoices processed without human intervention

caseStudies.cs3Challenge: A logistics operation was losing competitive advantage due to a slow invoicing cycle. caseStudies.cs3Solution: We integrated all data sources, driver apps, GPS systems, fuel cards, and delivery confirmation data, into a unified pipeline. about.title: Built before AI became fashion.
about.intro: Maxpromo Digital is an Essen-based business systems and automation company. Long before AI agents became mainstream, we were already working inside CMS platforms, hosting environments, databases, migrations and production systems. The technical depth came first. The AI layer came later.
about.storyBody: From Joomla and WordPress to Drupal and TYPO3. From shared hosting to WAMP environments, phpMyAdmin, SQL imports, .htaccess, PHP version management and production recovery. Maxpromo has worked across the full lifecycle of digital systems, including a complete migration of a Joomla website originally built around 2014 into a modern CI/CD deployment pipeline. That is legacy system transformation, not a website project.
